study_title: SYNERGY-AI: Artificial Intelligence Based Precision Oncology Clinical Trials Registry
brief_summary: The SYNERGY Registry is an international prospective, observational cohort study of eligible adult and pediatric patients with advanced solid and hematological malignancies, for whom the decision to consider CTE has already been made by their primary providers (PP).
detailed_description: Using a proprietary application programming interface (API) linked to existing electronic health records (EHR) platforms, individual clinical data is extracted, analyzed, and matched to a parametric database of existing institutional and non-institutional CT. Machine learning algorithms allow for dynamic matching based on CT allocation and availability for optimized matching. Patients voluntarily enroll into the non-interventional registry.
inclusion_criteria: Eligible adult and pediatric patients with advanced solid and hematological malignancies where consideration for clinical trial enrollment has been made.
eligibility_criteria: Clinical decision for trial eligibility is determined by the primary provider.

study_title: Phase 1 Study of INBRX-109 in Subjects with Locally Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors
brief_summary: First-in-human, open-label, non-randomized, three-part phase 1 trial of INBRX-109, a recombinant humanized tetravalent antibody targeting the human death receptor 5 (DR5).
detailed_description: Evaluates anti-tumor activity, safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and potential predictive response biomarkers of INBRX-109 monotherapy in advanced solid tumors.
inclusion_criteria: Histologically confirmed advanced/metastatic solid tumors.

study_title: Phase 1/2 Study of IDE196 in Patients with Solid Tumors Harboring GNAQ/11 Mutations or PRKC Fusions
brief_summary: Multi-center, open-label basket study evaluating safety and anti-tumor activity of IDE196 in patients with solid tumors with GNAQ or GNA11 mutations, or PRKC fusions.
detailed_description: Phase 1: Dose escalation to assess safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and determination of recommended Phase 2 dose. Phase 2: Dose expansion for anti-tumor activity.
inclusion_criteria: Solid tumors with specified molecular markers (GNAQ/GNA11/PRKC).

study_title: Radiation Therapy for the Treatment of Metastatic Gastrointestinal Cancer
brief_summary: This phase II trial studies how well radiation therapy works in treating patients with metastatic gastrointestinal cancer.
detailed_description: Patients undergo hypofractionated radiotherapy to one metastatic lesion then receive immune checkpoint blockade according to provider standard practice. Tumor response is evaluated after 2 cycles by RECIST criteria.
inclusion_criteria: Age ≥18 years, metastatic gastrointestinal cancer, planned immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy, eligible for radiotherapy.
exclusion_criteria: Prior radiotherapy to selected lesion, uncontrolled intercurrent illness.
eligibility_criteria: Participants must have confirmed metastatic gastrointestinal cancer.

study_title: Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, and Pharmacokinetics of the Drug in Chinese Subjects With Advanced Solid Tumors
brief_summary: A Phase I dose-escalation and expansion study in adult Chinese patients with advanced solid tumors.
detailed_description: The study aims to evaluate safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and preliminary anti-tumor activity.
inclusion_criteria: Histologically or cytologically confirmed advanced solid tumors, ECOG ≤2, adequate organ function.
exclusion_criteria: Uncontrolled systemic disease, prior therapies within a defined window.
eligibility_criteria: See above inclusion and exclusion details.

study_title: National Cancer Institute “Cancer Moonshot Biobank”
brief_summary: The Cancer Moonshot Biobank is collecting biospecimens and health information from consenting cancer patients.
detailed_description: Collected data and samples may support future cancer research and improve therapies and patient outcomes.
inclusion_criteria: Diagnosis of cancer and willingness to consent.
exclusion_criteria: None specified—open to broad cancer populations.

study_title: Study of Safety and Tolerability of BCA101 in Subjects With Advanced Solid Tumors
brief_summary: First-in-human study to evaluate safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and pharmacodynamics of BCA101.
detailed_description: Dose escalation and expansion in subjects with advanced solid tumors. Safety and anti-tumor activity will be measured.
inclusion_criteria: Advanced solid tumors refractory to standard therapy.
exclusion_criteria: Uncontrolled infection, significant cardiac dysfunction.

study_title: Expanded Access to Ulixertinib (BVD-523) in Subjects With Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors
brief_summary: Expanded access program for patients with no alternative treatment options.
detailed_description: Enables eligible participants access to Ulixertinib outside clinical trial setting.
inclusion_criteria: Advanced/metastatic solid tumors not amenable to curative therapies.
exclusion_criteria: Not specified.
eligibility_criteria: No curative or other treatment options available.

study_title: The Evaluation of PC14586 in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors Harboring a TP53 Y220C Mutation
brief_summary: First-in-human trial assessing safety and antitumor activity of PC14586 in patients with TP53 Y220C mutation.
detailed_description: Open-label multicenter trial including dose escalation and expansion phases.
inclusion_criteria: Confirmed TP53 Y220C mutation in advanced solid tumors.
exclusion_criteria: Patients with other active malignancies.

study_title: A Phase 1/2 Study of ART0380 for the Treatment of Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors
brief_summary: Evaluating ART0380 in adults with advanced or metastatic solid tumors.
detailed_description: Study designed to measure safety and efficacy of ART0380.
inclusion_criteria: Confirmed diagnosis, progressive disease, ECOG 0-1.
exclusion_criteria: Active infection, prior ART0380 exposure.

study_title: Testing the Combination of DS-8201a and Nivolumab in Subjects With HER2-Expressing Solid Tumors
brief_summary: Phase I study testing DS-8201a with nivolumab in patients with HER2-positive cancers.
detailed_description: Participants receive combination therapy; safety, pharmacokinetics, and preliminary efficacy assessed.
inclusion_criteria: HER2-positive cancer, measurable disease.

study_title: Collection of Samples USOPTIVAL Study
brief_summary: Study for collection of samples from cancer patients for diagnostic purposes.
detailed_description: Collected biological samples analyzed for diagnostic and research applications.
inclusion_criteria: Cancer diagnosis, consent to sample collection.

study_title: P-BCMA-ALLO1 Allogeneic CAR-T Cells in Adults with Relapsed/Refractory Multiple Myeloma
brief_summary: Study of P-BCMA-ALLO1 allogeneic CAR-T cells for adults with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.
detailed_description: Investigates safety, tolerability, and effectiveness of this therapy.
inclusion_criteria: Relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma after ≥3 prior therapies.
exclusion_criteria: Prior gene therapy products, active infection.

study_title: Study to Evaluate the Safety and Anti-cancer Activity of A2B694, a Logic-Gated CAR T Cell Therapy, in Subjects With Relapsed/Refractory Multiple Myeloma
brief_summary: A2B694 is a logic-gated CAR T cell therapy for multiple myeloma patients who have relapsed or are refractory.
detailed_description: Designed to assess safety, pharmacokinetics and preliminary efficacy in adult patients.
inclusion_criteria: Documented relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma after at least one prior therapy.
exclusion_criteria: Known central nervous system involvement, prior gene therapy.

study_title: Five or Ten Year Colonoscopy for 1-2 Non-Advanced Adenomas
brief_summary: Randomized trial of five vs. ten year surveillance colonoscopy after removal of 1-2 non-advanced adenomas.
detailed_description: Seeks to inform optimal surveillance intervals for patients with low-risk colorectal adenomas.
inclusion_criteria: Patients 45-75 years with 1-2 non-advanced adenomas removed.
exclusion_criteria: History of advanced adenomas, hereditary cancer syndromes.
eligibility_criteria: Eligible based on age and adenoma criteria.

study_title: A Beta-only IL-2 ImmunoTherapY Study
brief_summary: Phase I study of MDNA11 (Beta-only IL-2) in adults with advanced solid tumors.
detailed_description: Evaluates safety, tolerability, and dose of MDNA11 in dose escalation and expansion.
inclusion_criteria: Confirmed advanced or metastatic solid tumor, ECOG 0–1.
exclusion_criteria: Active autoimmune disease, prior allogeneic cell therapy.
eligibility_criteria: Full eligibility details in protocol document.

study_title: A Study of NX-1607 in Adults With Advanced Malignancies
brief_summary: First-in-human study to evaluate NX-1607 in advanced solid tumors and lymphomas.
detailed_description: Dose escalation and expansion assessing safety, pharmacokinetics, and preliminary efficacy.
inclusion_criteria: Advanced malignancy, measurable disease, prior therapy failure.
exclusion_criteria: Active CNS disease, prior treatment with anti-C4, COVID-19 risk.

study_title: First-Time-in-Human Study of GSK4381562 in Participants With Advanced Solid Tumors
brief_summary: First-in-human, open label study evaluating GSK4381562 in advanced solid tumors.
detailed_description: Dose escalation design for safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and preliminary efficacy.
inclusion_criteria: Confirmed advanced solid tumor, progression after standard therapies.
exclusion_criteria: Prior anti-C4 therapy, active CNS metastases.
eligibility_criteria: Eligibility according to inclusion and exclusion criteria.

study_title: Collecting Blood Samples from Patients With and Without Cancer to Detect Colorectal Cancer Earlier
brief_summary: Blood samples collection to support early detection research for colorectal cancer.
detailed_description: Samples will be analyzed for biomarkers to distinguish cancer from healthy states.
inclusion_criteria: Diagnosis of colorectal cancer or healthy status and willingness to provide blood samples.

study_title: Mass Response of Tumor Cells as a Biomarker for Rapid Therapy Response
brief_summary: Study aims to validate mass response of tumor cells as a rapid biomarker in cancer therapy.
detailed_description: Tumor cell samples are analyzed following therapy administration.
inclusion_criteria: Cancer diagnosis, planned treatment, consent.

study_title: Collecting Blood and Stool Samples to Detect Colorectal Cancer Earlier
brief_summary: Collecting biological samples for research on early detection of colorectal cancer.
detailed_description: Samples will provide data on diagnostic markers.
inclusion_criteria: Colorectal cancer or healthy status, willing to provide samples.

study_title: A Study of XMT-2056 in Advanced/Recurrent Solid Tumors
brief_summary: Investigates safety of XMT-2056 in adults with advanced or recurrent solid tumors.
detailed_description: Trial terminated after safety halt; enrolled participants evaluated for toxicities.
inclusion_criteria: Advanced or recurrent solid tumor diagnosis.

study_title: Observational Basket Trial to Collect Tissue to Train and Evaluate Molecular Artificial Intelligence Algorithms
brief_summary: Collection of tissue samples to train & evaluate AI algorithms for cancer diagnosis and treatment.
detailed_description: Basket trial includes molecular testing and AI-based evaluation.
inclusion_criteria: Solid tumor diagnosis, consent to provide tissue sample.

study_title: A Phase 1, First in Human, Dose Escalation and Expansion Study of SRF114
brief_summary: A first-in-human study to evaluate SRF114 in adults with advanced solid tumors or lymphomas.
detailed_description: The study assesses safety, tolerability, and sets the recommended phase II dose for future studies.
inclusion_criteria: Advanced solid tumors or lymphomas, refractory to standard therapies.
exclusion_criteria: Prior anti-CCR8 therapy, active CNS disease.

study_title: A Study of a Selective T Cell Receptor (TCR) Targeting Cancer-Testis Antigen NY-ESO-1 in Subjects With Advanced Solid Tumors
brief_summary: This trial evaluates a selective TCR therapy for tumors expressing NY-ESO-1 antigen.
detailed_description: Dose escalation and expansion in subjects with advanced cancer; assessing safety and early efficacy.
inclusion_criteria: Confirmed advanced solid tumor, NY-ESO-1 positive, progression after standard therapy.
exclusion_criteria: Prior TCR gene therapy, active CNS disease.

study_title: Testing the Addition of Total Ablative Therapy to Usual Treatment for Oligometastatic Colorectal Cancer
lead_sponsor_name: Alliance for Clinical Trials in Oncology
brief_summary: Comparing usual treatment with or without total ablative therapy in colorectal cancer.
detailed_description: Study evaluates progression-free survival, overall survival, and outcomes of aggressive local therapy.
inclusion_criteria: Diagnosis of oligometastatic colorectal cancer, suitable for ablative therapy.
exclusion_criteria: Uncontrolled comorbid illness, extensive extrahepatic disease.

study_title: Study of JANX008 in Subjects With Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors
brief_summary: A Phase 1, open-label study of JANX008 in patients with solid tumors.
detailed_description: Assesses safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetics to determine the recommended phase II dose.
inclusion_criteria: Advanced/metastatic tumor, progression following standard therapy.
exclusion_criteria: Active CNS metastasis, recent anticancer treatment.

study_title: A Study of PARG Inhibitor IDE161 in Participants With Advanced Solid Tumors
brief_summary: IDE161 PARG inhibitor dose escalation/expansion in adults with advanced solid tumors.
detailed_description: Study seeks recommended phase II dose, assesses safety, PK, and initial efficacy.
inclusion_criteria: Advanced solid tumor with disease progression after standard therapy.
exclusion_criteria: Recent anticancer therapy, active brain metastasis.

study_title: FOG-001 in Locally Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors
brief_summary: First-in-human, dose escalation/expansion study of FOG-001.
detailed_description: Examines antitumor activity of FOG-001 in adults with advanced cancers.
inclusion_criteria: Locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor, relapsed/refractory.
exclusion_criteria: Active/untreated CNS metastases, significant comorbidity.

study_title: The Immune Effects of Fermented Wheat Germ Nutritional Supplement With Standard Treatment in Cancer
lead_sponsor_name: Biomar Microbial Technologies (now part of PharmaMar)
brief_summary: Investigates effects of fermented wheat germ supplement in patients receiving standard cancer therapy.
detailed_description: Randomized, open-label trial evaluating immunomodulatory and antitumor effects.
inclusion_criteria: Cancer diagnosis eligible for standard therapy.
exclusion_criteria: Severe concurrent disease, recent immunotherapy.

study_title: Study of RMC-9805 in Participants With KRAS G12D-Mutated Solid Tumors
brief_summary: First-in-human, open-label, dose escalation and expansion for patients with KRAS G12D-mutated tumors.
detailed_description: Primary endpoints: safety, PK, recommended phase II dose.
inclusion_criteria: KRAS G12D-mutated cancer, progression after prior therapy.
exclusion_criteria: CNS metastases, uncontrolled infection.

study_title: A Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of A2B694, a Logic-Gated CAR T Cell Therapy, in Subjects With Advanced Solid Tumor Malignancies
brief_summary: A2B694, a logic-gated CAR T product, to be tested in multiple advanced solid tumors.
detailed_description: Dose escalation and expansion examining safety/efficacy as monotherapy and in combination.
inclusion_criteria: Documented advanced solid tumor malignancy.
exclusion_criteria: Prior CAR T therapy, CNS metastases.

study_title: Study of RMC-6291 in Combination with RMC-6236 in Subjects with KRAS G12C Mutated Solid Tumors
brief_summary: Evaluates safety, tolerability, and preliminary anti-tumor activity of RMC-6291 plus RMC-6236.
detailed_description: Open-label, multicenter, dose-escalation and expansion with new KRAS G12C agent combo.
inclusion_criteria: KRAS G12C-mutated solid cancer, prior standard therapy.
exclusion_criteria: Uncontrolled CNS disease, recent cytotoxic therapy.

study_title: A Phase 2 Study of Leronlimab in Combination With TAS-102 + Bevacizumab in Metastatic Colorectal Cancer
brief_summary: Study assessing safety and efficacy of leronlimab combined with TAS-102 and bevacizumab in metastatic colorectal cancer.
detailed_description: Open-label, multicenter study with endpoints of progression-free survival and overall survival.
inclusion_criteria: Histologically confirmed metastatic colorectal cancer after failure of prior standard therapies.
exclusion_criteria: Recent investigational agents, uncontrolled comorbid conditions.
eligibility_criteria: Eligibility according to inclusion/exclusion criteria in protocol.

study_title: A Study of MGC028 in Participants With Advanced Solid Tumors
brief_summary: Assessing MGC028 in patients with advanced solid tumors not responding to standard therapy.
detailed_description: Dose escalation and expansion; safety, pharmacokinetics, and efficacy are primary endpoints.
inclusion_criteria: Adults with advanced/metastatic solid tumors with progression after standard therapy.
exclusion_criteria: Active CNS metastases, uncontrolled medical conditions.

study_title: A Study of LY4257496 in Participants With Cancer (OMNIRAY)
brief_summary: First-in-human evaluation of LY4257496 in adults with solid or hematologic cancer.
detailed_description: Evaluates safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and preliminary efficacy across multiple tumor types.
inclusion_criteria: Confirmed solid or hematologic malignancy; measurable disease progression after treatment.
exclusion_criteria: CNS involvement, recent major surgery or therapy.

study_title: A Phase 1, Dose-escalation Study of [225Ac]-FPI-2068 in Participants With Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors Expressing B7-H3
brief_summary: [225Ac]-FPI-2068 is evaluated in adults for advanced/metastatic solid tumors with B7-H3 expression.
detailed_description: Dose escalation will determine safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and preliminary efficacy for targeted radiotherapy.
inclusion_criteria: Advanced/metastatic solid tumor, B7-H3 positive, progression after standard treatment.
exclusion_criteria: Prior treatment with radioimmunoconjugates, untreated CNS metastases.

study_title: A Study to Evaluate INCB161734 in Participants With Select Advanced Solid Tumors
brief_summary: First-in-human, open-label trial to evaluate safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetics of INCB161734 in solid tumors.
detailed_description: Participants undergo dose escalation and cohort expansion; endpoints include safety, PK, and antitumor activity.
inclusion_criteria: Histologically confirmed advanced solid tumor, measurable disease, progression following standard therapy.
exclusion_criteria: Active CNS disease or any condition interfering with trial participation.
eligibility_criteria: Eligibility defined by key protocol criteria.

study_title: A Study Evaluating FMC-376 in Participants With KRAS G12C-mutated Cancers
brief_summary: First-in-human trial of FMC-376 in KRAS G12C-mutated cancers.
detailed_description: Dose escalation and expansion to evaluate safety, PK, and early efficacy in relevant populations.
inclusion_criteria: KRAS G12C mutation, advanced solid tumor, progression/relapse after standard therapy.
exclusion_criteria: Active severe infections, symptomatic CNS involvement.

study_title: A Study of IBI363 in Subjects with Advanced Solid Tumors
brief_summary: IBI363 is evaluated in dose escalation and expansion cohorts for advanced solid tumors.
detailed_description: Primary goal is to determine safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and recommend phase II dose.
inclusion_criteria: Adult with unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor unresponsive to standard therapies.
exclusion_criteria: Concurrent anticancer therapy, severe comorbidities.

study_title: 64Cu-LNTH-1363S in Patients With Sarcoma or Other Advanced Cancers
brief_summary: Evaluating safety and imaging potential of 64Cu-LNTH-1363S in sarcoma or advanced cancer.
detailed_description: Assesses pharmacokinetics, safety, and tumor imaging/targeting properties.
inclusion_criteria: Confirmed sarcoma or advanced cancer, measurable by imaging modalities.
exclusion_criteria: Pregnant or breastfeeding, recent investigational product exposure.

study_title: A Phase I/IIa Study to Investigate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics and Activity of AZD1390 in Patients With Glioma
brief_summary: AZD1390 therapy is evaluated in glioma patients for safety, tolerability, and anti-tumor activity.
detailed_description: Study includes dose escalation, expansion for pharmacokinetics, initial response rates.
inclusion_criteria: Histologically confirmed glioma; progressive/recurrent after prior therapy.
exclusion_criteria: History of severe allergic reactions to AZD1390 or excipients.

study_title: A Study of Amivantamab and mFOLFOX6 or FOLFIRI in Participants With Advanced or Metastatic Colorectal Cancer With EGFR Exon 20 Insertions
brief_summary: Study investigates amivantamab in combination with chemotherapy for EGFR exon 20 mutated colorectal cancer.
detailed_description: Key outcomes: efficacy, safety, and tolerability of combination therapies.
inclusion_criteria: Colorectal cancer with confirmed EGFR exon 20 insertion, progressed after ≥1 prior systemic therapy.
exclusion_criteria: Current/previous other anti-EGFR therapy, active CNS metastases.
